en.title: Bloom Turn
en.blurb: Turn 2 by 2 blocks of tiles until four of a colour touch in a square and bloom. You have 30 turns to reach each level's target.
en.howto: Arrows or WASD move · Space or X turn clockwise · Z turn back · P pause · Mouse: click turns, right-click turns back · Touch: tap a block, tap it again to turn

zh-TW.title: 綻放轉轉
zh-TW.blurb: 旋轉 2×2 的方塊，讓四片同色磁磚拼成正方形並綻放。每關有 30 回合可以達成目標分數。
zh-TW.howto: 方向鍵或 WASD 移動 · 空白鍵或 X 順時針旋轉 · Z 逆時針旋轉 · P 暫停 · 滑鼠：左鍵順轉、右鍵逆轉 · 觸控：點選方塊，再點一次旋轉
